label: ElevenLabs Client
description: Turns text into speech with the user's ElevenLabs voices. Works without opening the client: the API key it was given is enough. When the client does happen to be open, the generation joins its history and cache.

actions.name: speak
actions.summary: Say some text out loud in one of the user's ElevenLabs voices. Does not need the ElevenLabs client open.

voice.description: Which voice, by name. Defaults to the first one.

actions.name: save_speech
actions.summary: Generate speech from text and save it as an mp3 file, without playing it. Use this to make an audio file the user keeps.

actions.name: get_status
actions.summary: Say whether ElevenLabs is configured - whether an API key is set, and where it was found. Check this before reporting that speech cannot be generated.

actions.name: set_api_key
actions.summary: Save the user's ElevenLabs API key so speech can be generated. Only ever call this with a key the user actually gave you.

actions.name: list_voices
actions.summary: List the voices in the user's ElevenLabs account.

actions.name: set_voice
actions.summary: Choose which ElevenLabs voice the open client speaks with. Only meaningful while the client is open; pass 'voice' to speak instead.
